snippet.title: Rollerball — Official Launch Trailer | Arcade Marble Adventure
snippet.description:
Roll at breakneck speed, collect lost Spark Stars, dodge lethal sweepers, and race into the portal before the world collapses.

Rollerball is a fast-paced arcade marble adventure blending momentum physics, tight precision controls, and obstacle courses across 4 escalating worlds.

DOWNLOAD AND PLAY NOW:
- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sammx.rollerball
- Web / Browser: https://games.sammx.com/

GAME FEATURES:
- Pure Arcade Momentum: Master slope acceleration, apex jumps, and narrow bridge navigation.
- 20 Handcrafted Levels: Journey through Mountain Pass, Crystal Caverns, Storm Cliffs, and The Void.
- Strict Victory Rule: Every Spark Star must be recovered to energize and unlock the exit portal.
- Deep Upgrades: Enhance your marble with Speed Boosts, Magnet Radius, Kinetic Shields, and the legendary Void Obsidian Core.
- Mobile and PC Optimized: Clean, responsive tactile controls designed for low-latency reflexes.

TRAILER CHAPTERS:
0:00 - The World (Mountain Pass)
0:03 - The Marble Drops
0:05 - The Basics & First Spark
0:07 - Precision Chasm Leap
0:11 - Ball Upgrade Showroom
0:16 - The Void Climax (Level 20 Full Run)
0:35 - Golden Portal Warp & End Card

CONNECT WITH US:
- Website: https://games.sammx.com/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/samm.games/
